answers.answer: 'Yes, stars on (Recommended)': switch on the Ruling-B star of each of the 16 records and remove its too-broad number, so the bonus applies only where print limits it
answers.rule: ruling #126 (2026-08-22, a value is a real number only when it is ALWAYS on; a condition the sheet cannot see is a star) and print on each record, e.g. equipment-2314-2161 (Clarity Goggles): "While wearing the goggles, you gain a +1 item bonus to visual Perception checks." and feat-6380 (Rope Runner): "You gain a climb Speed of 15 feet, but only when climbing ropes and similar objects."
answers.note: His pick in chat, 2026-10-17: 'Yes, stars on (Recommended)'. The question, as asked: '16 items/feats show a bonus on EVERY roll although the book limits it (e.g. Clarity Goggles +3 to all Perception, book: only checks that use sight). Their correct starred note exists but is switched off because Wanderer's Guide has no note there. Switch those stars on and remove the too-broad numbers?' The 16: items bagpipes-of-turmoil, borts-blessing, clarity-goggles-greater, day-goggles, eye-slash-greater, eye-slash-major, eye-slash-true, holy-chain, mirror-goggles-lesser, persona-mask, persona-mask-greater, razmiri-wayfinder, resonant-guitar, shining-hackle, wardrobe-stone-greater, and feats rope-runner (its situational star and the cat-rope-runner mode; its standing climb 15 goes). Fix: one `situational` approval per record in scripts/data/trust-approvals.json, then one overlay row per record retiring the number through scripts/apply-parity-fixes.mjs.

answers.answer: 'Unarmed only (Recommended)': option (a), as print says - only unarmed attacks in the brawling group get the critical specialization effect from Expert Strikes; brawling WEAPONS (gauntlet, knuckle-duster, spiked gauntlet) lose it
answers.rule: print, class-feature-938 (Expert Strikes, Monk, Player Core 2 pg. 114): "When you get a critical hit with an unarmed attack in the brawling group, you get its critical specialization effect."
answers.note: His pick in chat, 2026-10-17: 'Unarmed only (Recommended)'. Fix: one overlay row on classFeatures/expert-strikes, critSpecWeapons { groups: ['brawling'], categories: ['unarmed'] } (derive.ts weaponMatches: `categories` is a gate the Strike must pass AND the group narrowing must match), why citing class-feature-938 and desk #176. A 5th-level monk's Fist keeps the effect; a gauntlet does not.
